title: Reorder quantity with names that survive six months
task: In package `replenish`, compute whether a SKU needs reordering and how much: given on-hand units, units already on order, average daily demand, supplier lead time in days, and a safety stock, the reorder point is daily demand times lead time plus safety stock, and if on-hand plus on-order is at or below it, order enough to bring that position up to the reorder point plus one lead time of demand. Make the names carry the meaning; I will be reading this in six months. Test a case that reorders and one that does not.
